content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-60. - Signatures remain valid.
content.summary:
In case any of the officers whose signatures appear on any bonds or coupons cease
               to be such officers before the delivery of such bonds, such signatures nevertheless
               shall be valid and sufficient for all purposes the same as if they had remained in
               office…

faqs.a:
In case any of the officers whose signatures appear on any bonds or coupons cease
               to be such officers before the delivery of such bonds, such signatures nevertheless
               shall be valid and sufficient for all purposes the same as if they had remained in
               office until such delivery.
(Code 1981, § 14-29; Ord. No. 1248, § 13(3), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-215(3).
